newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond yield curve flattens sharply.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond yield curve flattens sharply.

text.p: The Australian bond yield curve flattened sharply on Tuesday as hopes of an imminent cut in domestic interest rates appeared to evaporate, traders said.

The three-/10-year bond futures spread narrowed to its lowest level in a week as an unexpectedly strong retail trade report for July was expected to see today's Reserve Bank board meeting leave monetary policy unchanged.
Yield spreads also blew out sharply on the data, more than reversing Monday's tightening which had seen the 10-year margin to the U.S. as low as 115 basis points.

Adding to the local slide in prices was a report in the Wall Street Journal saying that Federal Reserve policy makers are leaning towards a larger than expected 50 basis point tightening unless clear signs of slower growth emerges.
U.S. Treasuries weakened in Tokyo trading on the report, while the New York market faces the U.S. NAPM index for August later today after returning from Monday's labor Day holiday
